preparation_note: The earlier Biblioteca Nacional de México scholarly pointer to the eponymous article on p. 2 is now superseded by direct inspection of the exact primary page. The fixed stanza is deliberately source-critical: the periodical personifies itself speaking to children, claims to provide useful teaching and explicitly compares its corrective role with that of a teacher. This self-description is retained as evidence about the newspaper's own pedagogical positioning rather than as an externally verified account of classroom practice.
